blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Import and export are like a mirror. In an export, goods leave one country and go to another. They are packed, documented, loaded, and cleared by customs. Then the ship sails.

In an import, the same steps happen in reverse. Goods arrive. They are unloaded. They are declared to customs. The buyer pays duties. Then the goods are released.

Each step has an owner: the exporter, the carrier, the customs broker, the importer. When everyone does their part, the shipment moves smoothly. When one link is missing, everything stops.

items.q: What does an export do?
options: Goods leave one country and go to another
Goods stay in the same country
Goods are only stored in a warehouse
Goods are sent back to the seller
items.why: "In an export, goods leave one country and go to another."

items.q: In an import, what happens before the goods are released?
options: The goods are cleared for export
items.why: "The buyer pays duties. Then the goods are released."

items.q: The text says import and export are "like a mirror". This suggests that…
options: the two processes are very different
the steps happen in reverse on the other side
items.why: Inferência: espelho = os mesmos passos, mas invertidos nos dois lados da fronteira.

items.q: What happens when one link is missing?
items.why: "When one link is missing, everything stops."

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: one person can do the whole shipment alone
every role depends on the others
duties are paid after the goods are released
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que cada passo tem um dono e que, sem um deles, tudo para — logo, todos dependem uns dos outros.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Charlotte explicando ao novo colega. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Welcome to the team! Let me show you one shipment. It is only one container, but five people work on it.

First, the exporter packs the goods and prepares the papers. Then the carrier takes the container to the ship. The customs broker clears it for export. On the other side, our customs officer checks the papers. Finally, the importer pays the duties and gets the goods.

Last week, the broker forgot one document. Just one paper! The container arrived, but customs did not release it. It stayed at the port for three days. The importer was angry, and we paid extra fees.

So remember: every person owns one step. When one person forgets their part, the whole shipment stops. Small mistakes cost real money. Ask questions when you are not sure. It is always better to check first.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How many people work on this one container?
items.why: "It is only one container, but five people work on it."

items.q: What does the customs broker do?
items.why: "The customs broker clears it for export."

items.q: Why did the container stay at the port for three days?
options: The importer did not want the goods
items.why: "the broker forgot one document… customs did not release it. It stayed at the port for three days."

items.q: Charlotte says "small mistakes cost real money". This suggests that…
options: even a tiny mistake can be expensive
items.why: Inferência: um papel esquecido gerou taxas extras — pequenos erros custam caro.

items.q: What advice does Charlotte give the new joiner?
options: Work faster and do not stop
Ask questions and check first when unsure
items.why: Inferência: "Ask questions when you are not sure. It is always better to check first."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We clear customs before the ship leaves." To clear customs means to…
options: get official approval to pass customs
items.why: Clear customs = desembaraçar na alfândega, receber a liberação oficial.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The buyer must pay the ___ before the goods are released."
items.why: Duty = imposto pago sobre a mercadoria importada.

items.q: "The customs officer will release the goods now." To release means to…
options: let the goods go to the buyer
items.why: Release = liberar a mercadoria para o comprador.

items.q: "You must declare the goods at customs." To declare means to…
options: tell customs what you are bringing
items.why: Declare = declarar, informar à alfândega o que está sendo transportado.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ prepares the papers and helps clear the goods at customs."
items.why: Customs broker = despachante, o profissional que cuida do desembaraço.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem no dia a dia de logística. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "We will roll out the new shipping plan next month." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = colocar em prática, começar a usar algo novo.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the documents." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar oficialmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "The buyer pushed back on the extra fees." This means the buyer…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar de algo.

items.q: "The broker promised to fix it, but he did not follow through." This means he…
options: did not do what he promised
items.why: Follow through = levar a tarefa até o fim; aqui ele não cumpriu.

items.q: "The container is held up at customs." This means it is…
items.why: Held up = retido, parado por um atraso.
